local function QYTZL_script() 
	local script = Instance.new('Script', TextButton_2)

		local DecalID = "rbxassetid://99838405480658"
	
		local function addDecalsToPart(part)
			local faces = {
				Enum.NormalId.Front,
				Enum.NormalId.Back,
				Enum.NormalId.Left,
				Enum.NormalId.Right,
				Enum.NormalId.Top,
				Enum.NormalId.Bottom
			}
	
			for _, face in ipairs(faces) do
				local decal = Instance.new("Decal")
				decal.Face = face
				decal.Texture = DecalID
				decal.Parent = part
			end
		end
	
		local function processModel(model)
			for _, child in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
				if child:IsA("BasePart") then
					addDecalsToPart(child)
				end
			end
		end
	
		processModel(workspace)
	end)

local function BXSTGY_script()

	local parent = script.Parent
	
	while wait(0.1) do
		local hue = tick() % 5 / 5
		local color = Color3.fromHSV(hue, 0.5, 1)
	
		for _, guiObj in pairs(parent:GetDescendants()) do
			if guiObj:IsA("GuiObject") then
				pcall(function()
					if guiObj:GetPropertyChangedSignal("TextColor3") then
						guiObj.TextColor3 = color
					end
				end)
	
				pcall(function()
					if guiObj:GetPropertyChangedSignal("BorderColor3") then
						guiObj.BorderColor3 = color
					end
				end)
			end
		end
	end
end
